name: A cow and calf, with a crouching figure
summary: A drawing of a cow and calf with a crouching figure. The shorthand inscription refers to the artist's arrival in Dublin on 22 December 1796, a date to which he referred in another shorthand note in a drawing in the HSBC colllection (sketchbook 1, f.34).

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
